15234a444ebdabdb.description: Cotton & Clay Collective  Candidate-facing Job DescriptionFinance ControllerCotton & Clay CollectiveLocation: Chandigarh, IndiaFunction: Finance, Control & Commercial PlanningReporting to: Managing Director & CEOLevel: LeadershipAbout Cotton & ClayCotton & Clay Collective is building a digital-first fashion and lifestyle business for the Indian market. Our ambition is to create well-made, well-priced clothing that customers genuinely want to wear, supported by disciplined sourcing, strong product quality, a distinctive brand identity, technology-led operations and an exceptional digital customer experience.We are building the business for scale from the outset. That means every leadership and specialist role is expected to operate across functions, use data intelligently, protect commercial economics and help create repeatable operating capability rather than simply execute a narrow job description.The OpportunityThe Finance Controller is responsible for building the financial control architecture behind Cotton & Clays growth. The role combines controllership, planning, cash and working-capital management, commercial finance, management reporting, statutory readiness and stewardship of the Money module. In a product business where inventory, marketing and cash timing can destroy otherwise attractive growth, Finance must be embedded in decisions rather than report history after the fact.The mandate is clear: Give leadership a reliable financial truth, protect cash and control, challenge commercial assumptions, and ensure every material growth decision is understood through revenue, margin, working-capital and cash consequences.Key Responsibilities1. Financial Control & AccountingEstablish accurate books, controls and close discipline.Own chart of accounts, accounting policies, reconciliations, journals and month-end close.Ensure revenue, inventory, landed cost, returns, marketing and operating expenses are recognised consistently.Maintain supporting evidence for material balances and transactions.Drive timely resolution of reconciling items and control exceptions.2. Cash & LiquidityMaintain forward visibility of cash, not merely bank balances.Build rolling cash forecasts covering inventory commitments, marketing, payroll, tax and operating expenditure.Identify liquidity pressure early and propose corrective actions.Govern payment controls, approval limits and banking access.Optimise supplier-payment timing without damaging critical relationships.3. Working Capital & Inventory FinanceTreat inventory as both a commercial asset and financial exposure.Track inventory investment, ageing, turns, markdown exposure and cash conversion.Partner with Merchandising to challenge buy depth, reorder and clearance economics.Reconcile financial inventory to operational stock records.Model landed-cost and margin effects of freight, duties, FX and supplier terms.4. Planning, Forecasting & ScenariosTranslate strategy into a financially coherent plan.Own annual budget, rolling forecast and scenario planning.Maintain driver-based assumptions for demand, margin, marketing, returns, fulfilment and headcount.Explain variance through business drivers rather than accounting labels.Stress-test downside cases and funding requirements before commitments are made.5. Commercial FinanceBring Finance into customer, product and channel decisions.Evaluate category, SKU, channel, customer and campaign economics.Partner with Growth on CAC, MER, contribution and payback thresholds.Support pricing, promotion and markdown decisions with margin analysis.Challenge revenue growth that does not create sufficient contribution or cash value.6. Management ReportingProvide decision-grade information to leadership.Produce concise monthly packs covering P&L, balance sheet, cash, working capital and operating drivers.Maintain consistent metric definitions across Finance and operating modules.Highlight risks, opportunities and actions rather than numbers without interpretation.Provide board and investor-ready financial information when required.7. Tax, Statutory & ComplianceMaintain statutory readiness as the business scales.Coordinate GST, corporate tax, payroll tax and applicable filings with external advisors where necessary.Maintain documentation and calendars for regulatory obligations.Support audits, due diligence and banking requirements.Escalate compliance risks early and track remediation.8. Procurement & Spend GovernanceStrengthen discipline across third-party spend.Review material contracts, purchase commitments and recurring vendor spend.Maintain approval controls and budget ownership.Identify duplicated, underused or poorly negotiated spend.Partner with functions to improve commercial terms without compromising capability.9. Systems & Money ModuleMake the financial system the governed source of truth.Own business rules, assumptions and finance workflows in the Money module.Ensure changes to key assumptions are auditable and version-controlled.Partner with Technology on finance integrations and automation.Reduce spreadsheet dependency while preserving appropriate analytical flexibility.10. Finance Capability & GovernanceBuild a finance function that can support growth without losing control.Define future finance roles, outsource-versus-in-house decisions and segregation of duties.Maintain maker-checker discipline for payments and sensitive changes.Document critical processes and continuity coverage.Build a culture where Finance is commercially constructive but independent in control matters.How We Will Measure SuccessThe role will be assessed primarily on outcomes, operating quality and sustained business impact rather than activity.Financial ReliabilityClose timeliness and reconciliation qualityForecast accuracy and variance explanationStatutory filing timelinessControl exceptions and remediationCash & Working CapitalCash-runway visibilityInventory turns and ageingCash conversion and supplier termsWorking-capital forecast accuracyCommercial ValueContribution-margin visibilityBudget productivitySavings and term improvementsQuality of financial decision supportThe CandidateFinance leader who combines technical control with commercial understanding.Comfortable challenging executives using evidence and economic logic.Strong grasp of inventory accounting, working capital and consumer-commerce unit economics.Able to design controls proportionate to a high-growth company.Highly reliable with sensitive information and payment authority.Strong modelling and scenario-analysis capability.Clear communicator who makes finance understandable to non-finance leaders.Bias toward systemised auditable processes.Preferred ExperienceQualified CA, CMA, CPA or equivalent strong accounting and finance background.Controller, FP&A or commercial-finance leadership in retail, D2C, consumer goods or inventory-led business.Hands-on month-end close, cash forecasting and management reporting.Strong understanding of GST and Indian tax/compliance environment or experience managing specialist advisors.Inventory and landed-cost accounting.Financial modelling and scenario planning.Finance systems and controls implementation.Exposure to banking, audit, fundraising or investor reporting is useful.Leadership & Working AttributesIndependent  protects financial truth even when inconvenient.Commercial  understands why the business makes or loses money. About the Team
The APAC team is responsible for bringing OpenAI’s mission, products, and partnerships to life across one of the company’s most strategically important regions. As we scale our presence across Asia-Pacific, we are building a regional operating model that enables strong local execution, consistent global alignment, and long-term impact across businesses, products, markets, and functions.
About the Role
We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Lead to lead and scale operational excellence across India. Reporting to the Managing Director, India, this leader will work hand in hand with the MD to translate global strategy into regional execution, ensure operating discipline across markets and functions, and help the business scale with consistency, speed, and rigor.
This person will act as a key bridge between global leadership and regional teams, bringing clarity to priorities, building scalable operating systems, and ensuring the region is set up to deliver against ambitious business goals while keeping the long-term opportunity in mind.
This role is based in Bangalore, India and we use a hybrid model of 3 days in office.
In this role, you will:
• 
Define and implement the India operating strategy in alignment with APAC & global objectives and regional priorities.
• 
Drive execution across key markets, ensuring consistency while adapting to local needs, regulations, and market dynamics.
• 
Partner with global leadership to prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, and ensure strong execution in-region.
• 
Establish KPIs, reporting frameworks, and operating cadences to track performance and inform decision-making.
• 
Build and optimize scalable processes across business lines, including consumer, product, partnerships, and other key functions.
• 
Identify operational gaps and inefficiencies, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives.
• 
Support market entry strategies and operational readiness for India
• 
Enable strategic partnerships through strong operational frameworks and close partnership with relevant teams.
• 
Help build a strong regional functional leadership team and ensuring the regional operating system runs smoothly and efficiently.
• 
Collaborate closely across functions to drive accountability and deliver against regional goals.
• 
Ensure seamless coordination between global and regional stakeholders.
• 
Act as a central point of accountability for operational delivery across India.
• 
Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing regional operations team.
• 
Foster a culture of accountability, inclusion, operational rigor, and continuous learning.
• 
Develop leadership bench strength across key markets and functions.
You might thrive in this role if you have:
• 
Significant experience leading regional or international operations in a fast-scaling, complex business environment.
• 
Strong strategic and operational judgment, with the ability to translate high-level goals into clear execution plans.
• 
Experience operating across multiple markets, functions, and business lines, ideally within India.
• 
A track record of building scalable operating systems, processes, metrics, and reporting frameworks.
• 
Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across global and regional teams.
• 
Excellent business judgment, with a bias toward action and strong accountability for outcomes.
• 
Experience supporting market expansion, operational readiness, and/or regional growth initiatives.
• 
Strong people leadership skills, including experience building and developing high-performing teams.
• 
Comfort operating in ambiguity and creating structure in fast-moving environments.
• 
High integrity, low ego, and a collaborative leadership style.
• 
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to bring clarity to complex topics.

Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

Duties

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

Our Technology Stack

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

·       Documentation – Hudu

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

·       Networking – Meraki

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

·       Door Access – Avigilon

Qualification

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

·       High level of attention to detail

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

Our Core Values

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

Client Driven Results

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

Own Your Progress

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.
